hero.badge: Smart Agri Marketplace & Direct Supply Chain
hero.desc: Connect directly with verified buyers, discover fair crop prices and deliver your harvest with transparent logistics and 100% escrow protection.

features.title: Why Farmers & Buyers Choose KrishiSarthi
features.subtitle: Eliminating intermediaries, reducing wastage, and securing payments with cutting-edge technology.
features.f1_desc: Eliminate commission agents (aarhtiyas). Trade directly with millers, food processors, and bulk retailers.
features.f2_desc: Real-time MSP and wholesale mandi reference index so you know the exact intrinsic value of your produce.
features.f3_desc: Distance and load-optimized transport booking with live truck route telemetry and transparent freight bidding.
features.f4_desc: Funds are securely deposited prior to transit and disbursed automatically upon delivery verification.

market_preview.title: Fresh Farm Harvests Ready for Procurement
market_preview.subtitle: Discover certified grain, pulse, vegetable, and cash crop listings directly from farmers.

intelligence.title: Know Your Crop's Real Worth
intelligence.subtitle: Transparent price breakdown showing mandi benchmarks versus direct KrishiSarthi net realizations.
intelligence.comparison_note: Based on actual grain transactions across Haryana, Punjab, and Uttar Pradesh mandis.

logistics.title: Smart Logistics from Farm Gate to Mandi
logistics.subtitle: Optimized delivery routing with verified commercial transporters and live GPS tracking.
logistics.card1_desc: Transparent per-quintal and per-km pricing calibrated to current diesel rates.
logistics.card2_desc: Matching your produce volume with the ideal carrier: Mini Truck (1.5T), 6-Tyre (9T), or 10-Tyre (16T).
logistics.card3_desc: Drivers place competitive bids so you always get the most economical transport quote.
logistics.card4_desc: Both farmer and buyer monitor truck milestones, route polylines, and delivery ETAs.

steps.title: How KrishiSarthi Works
steps.step1_desc: Post your harvest via text or our Hindi Voice Assistant. Generate your batch QR code instantly.
steps.step2_desc: Receive direct price offers from verified bulk buyers across India without middlemen.
steps.step3_desc: Accept the highest bid or propose a counter-offer. Order is confirmed upon acceptance.
steps.step4_desc: Assigned transporter picks up the cargo. Once delivery is verified, escrow payment is released instantly.

cta.title: Grow Better. Trade Smarter.
cta.desc: Join thousands of farmers, wholesale buyers, and commercial transporters building India's premier digital agricultural network.

footer.desc: KrishiSarthi is India's leading Smart Agricultural Marketplace and transparent farm supply chain platform.
